apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: train-sweep-214-trial-07
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: train
        image: registry.example.com/research-train:latest
        command: ["python", "train.py", "--config", "configs/trial_07.yaml"]
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
      restartPolicy: Never
  backoffLimit: 2
caption: A Deployment restarts forever; a Job gives up after backoffLimit attempts and reports failure.
